say:3:1028220001:1.text: The medicine worked great! You two really are worthy of being the magister's familiars. My foot doesn't hurt at all!
say:3:1028220001:1.source_cn: 这药好神奇……您真不愧是大魔法师的使魔，我的脚一下子就...
say:3:1028220001:1.male: The medicine worked great! You two really are worthy of being the magister's familiars. My foot doesn't hurt at all!
say:3:1028220001:1.female: The medicine worked great! You two really are worthy of being the magister's familiars. My foot doesn't hurt at all!

say:4:1028220002:1.text: Then let's have a duel. This time, Chippy will fight you!
say:4:1028220002:1.source_cn: 那我们来比剑吧，这次满满来和你比！

say:5:1028220003:1.text: N-No need. I already know swordsmanship isn't my gift from Misarte.
say:5:1028220003:1.source_cn: ……不、不用了。我已经知道了，弥萨忒赐给我的也不是剑术天赋。

say:6:1028220004:1.text: Even when I was just practicing alone, I poked myself a few times... A divine gift wouldn't make me so clumsy.
say:6:1028220004:1.source_cn: 我刚才试练时，戳到自己好几次……神赐的天赋才不会这样笨...

say:7:1028220005:1.text: I-I'm starting to doubt if I'll ever discover my true calling.
say:7:1028220005:1.source_cn: 我……我开始怀疑了，我真的找到天赋吗？

choice_prompt:8:1028220005.text: I-I'm starting to doubt if I'll ever discover my true calling.
choice_prompt:8:1028220005.source_cn: 我……我开始怀疑了，我真的找到天赋吗？

say:9:1028220006:1.text: You mean I should keep trying? But after so many times... I'm just tired.
say:9:1028220006:1.source_cn: 您是说，我该坚持下去？可试了这么多次，都没有找到正确的...
say:9:1028220006:1.male: You mean I should keep trying? But after so many times... I'm just tired.
say:9:1028220006:1.female: You mean I should keep trying? But after so many times... I'm just tired.

say:10:1028220007:1.text: What <style="stress"><player_name></style> means is that finding one's talent isn't something that happens right away.
say:10:1028220007:1.male: What <style="stress"><player_name></style> means is that finding one's talent isn't something that happens right away.
say:10:1028220007:1.female: What <style="stress"><player_name></style> means is that finding one's talent isn't something that happens right away.

say:11:1028220008:1.text: Right! When you're tired, you should rest. Only by resting can one be more efficient. Resting isn't giving up. Even the gods understand that!
say:11:1028220008:1.source_cn: 对！累了就要休息，休息好了才更有效率——这可不算半途而...

say:12:1028220009:1.text: Misarte never said that, but... it does make sense.
say:12:1028220009:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒并没有降下那种启示……不过听起来……似乎很有道理。

say:13:1028220010:1.text: Oh, we're almost to my favorite field of flowers...
say:13:1028220010:1.source_cn: 哦，这里快到我很喜欢的那片花田了……

say:14:1028220011:1.text: Thank you for your help. I think I'll rest for a while!
say:14:1028220011:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们的帮助，我要去好好休息一阵子！

say:15:1028220012:1.text: Wait, Randy... That's not the way back to the academy!
say:15:1028220012:1.source_cn: ……等等，兰迪，那不是回学院的路！

choice:8:0:1.text: You will, but it takes time.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 当然，这需要足够的时间
choice:8:0:1.male: You will, but it takes time.
choice:8:0:1.female: You will, but it takes time.
